About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 90 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Responsibilities

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and continuous iteration of the company-wide user engagement platform, covering channels including Push Notifications, In-App Messaging, Email, and SMS.
  • Establish a centralized communication calendar and resource management mechanism to improve visibility across business teams and reduce overlapping, duplicated, or excessive user outreach.
  • Build user preference and consent management capabilities to enable differentiated communication based on users’ region, language, lifecycle stage, behavior, preferences, and consent status.
  • Design and continuously optimize company-wide user communication governance mechanisms.
  • Lead the core product direction of the engagement platform, including unified data dashboards, event-triggered messaging engines, journey orchestration, and cross-channel frequency control.
  • Drive the implementation of AI-powered personalization capabilities, including optimal send-time prediction, personalized content generation, and intelligent user segmentation.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources across Operations, Engineering, Data, Compliance, and other stakeholders to enable effective cross-channel collaboration and execution.
  • Establish a comprehensive measurement framework for user engagement effectiveness and use data insights to drive continuous product optimization.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Product Management experience, preferably with platform products, CRM, notification platforms, growth platforms, or user engagement products.
  • Strong understanding of major user communication channels and related product mechanisms, including Push Notifications, Email, SMS, and In-App Messaging.
  • Experience with data products involving cross-channel attribution, user segmentation, and A/B testing.
  • Experience with large-scale platform governance, workflow management, permission systems, approval mechanisms, prioritization frameworks, or rules engines.
  • Strong platform product mindset, with the ability to abstract diverse business requirements into standardized, scalable, and reusable product capabilities.
  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify user engagement issues through data and translate insights into product improvements.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across Product, Marketing, Growth, Operations, Engineering, Data, and Compliance teams.
  • Familiarity with user lifecycle management, segmentation, personalization, experimentation frameworks, consent management, and engagement analytics is highly preferred.
  • Experience in internet platforms, fintech, crypto, e-commerce, social platforms, or other large-scale consumer-facing businesses is preferred.
Why Join Us
 
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. Our benefits include:
  • Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
  • Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
  • Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
  • Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
  • Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
descriptions.job-10vkc2p:
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team

To sustain the company's growth, you'll join the Security Engineering team and will be the hands-on security architect for the applications and SaaS tools Ledger runs on: identity, collaboration, customer support, finance and the vendors behind them. You set the architecture standards, take on the hardest threat models yourself, and make sure data exposure through a vendor or an integration is found by us first.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead threat modelling and risk assessment of enterprise applications, SaaS tools and their integrations, hands-on, starting with the most critical tools and suppliers.

  • Set the security architecture standards and reusable patterns for enterprise systems: identity and SSO, access and least privilege, endpoints, network access, logging, data protection and integration tokens.

  • Review new applications, SaaS purchases and major changes at design stage, and agree the conditions for going live.

  • Design data masking and least-privilege access for customer support and customer-data tools.

  • Use offensive security techniques to challenge every design the way an attacker would, and work with the Red Team and external testers to validate it.

  • Turn findings into owned, dated actions, with the GRC team for the risk register.

  • Mentor the security engineers and help them grow into architecture work.

     
 

What we’re looking for

  • 10+ years in security engineering or architecture, including 5+ years in architecture and threat modelling for enterprise and cloud environments, and still hands-on.

  • Solid knowledge across the security disciplines: AWS, networking, endpoints, identity and access management (SSO, OAuth, OIDC), application and API security, and SaaS security.

  • Knowledge of offensive security techniques: how attackers abuse identities, integrations, tokens and endpoints, and how they move once inside.

  • Ability to challenge engineering and IT leads, and to be heard.

  • Fluent English is a must; French is a plus.

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

For regionally specific benefits, your Talent Acquisition contact will be able to provide you with more information.

 

We’re committed to building an inclusive hiring process. If you need any adjustments or accommodations, just let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

descriptions.job-12aegip:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

We’re looking for a Senior Recruiting Coordinator to deliver an exceptional candidate and interviewer experience and help lead the day-to-day work of our global coordination team. You’ll own complex interview scheduling, bring deep Ashby expertise, use metrics to improve performance, and mentor fellow coordinators. You’ll also manage the day-to-day work of the AI agents we’re building to support recruiting coordination.

Partnering closely with Talent Operations, you’ll improve how our people, systems, and AI agents work together. This is a hands-on role for someone who communicates proactively, brings solutions, and moves with urgency, with opportunities to grow into people management over time.

The impact you will have:

  • Own complex interview scheduling across teams and time zones, delivering a responsive, well-organized experience for candidates and interviewers.

  • Serve as the team’s Ashby expert, resolving scheduling issues, coaching coordinators, and partnering with Talent Operations to improve workflows.

  • Own day-to-day coordination operations and support Talent Operations projects, keeping Ashby records, interview plans, and scheduling data accurate and up to date.

  • Drive coordination performance through accurate reporting on interview volume, time to schedule, SLA adherence, reschedules, and candidate and interviewer feedback.

  • Develop fellow coordinators through onboarding, training, and practical coaching, helping the team manage priorities, workloads, and coverage.

  • Manage AI agents that support recruiting coordination, reviewing their work, resolving exceptions, and improving their accuracy and reliability with Talent Operations.

  • Partner closely with recruiters and the Talent team, aligning on priorities, communicating risks early, and bringing clear recommendations that keep interviews moving.

What we’re looking for:

  • 4+ years of recruiting coordination experience, with demonstrated success managing complex, high-volume scheduling in a fast-moving environment.

  • Advanced Ashby expertise is required, including interview plans, interviewer pools, scheduling links, calendar integrations, and independent troubleshooting.

  • Experience supporting Talent Operations or coordination operations, including ATS data quality, workflow maintenance, and process documentation.

  • Strong command of Ashby reporting and coordination metrics, with a track record of translating data into better scheduling outcomes.

  • Experience mentoring coordinators, leading training, and helping teammates use Ashby confidently and effectively.

  • Clear, proactive communication and the ability to build trusted partnerships with candidates, interviewers, recruiters, and Talent Operations.

  • Sound judgment and a strong sense of urgency: you investigate problems, recommend solutions, and follow through without repeated direction.

  • Applied AI fluency, including writing instructions, evaluating outputs, and identifying when human judgment is needed. Experience managing AI agents is a strong plus.

About the Team:

  • Our talent team is fully remote, embracing async communication and collaboration through Slack channels, thorough documentation, and proactive updates to keep work moving forward smoothly across time zones.

  • We hold weekly RC team syncs to review priorities and solve coordination challenges. Coordinators also participate in hiring syncs for the roles they support, staying close to candidate progress, hiring decisions, and upcoming needs.

  • Driven by a dedication to our craft, we continuously refine our best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for both internal stakeholders and candidates, supported by precise, reliable reporting.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Based in the Pacific Time Zone, working 8:30 a.m.–5:30 p.m. PT.

  • As a globally distributed team, we operate across various time zones, yet most of us overlap for collaboration and meetings between 7 a.m.–12 p.m. PT.

  • An active scheduling workload alongside coordination operations, Ashby data maintenance, mentoring, reporting, and AI agent oversight.

  • Advance coverage planning for holidays and absences, with clear owners and next steps.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • When an interviewer cancels, you promptly identify alternatives, recommend a solution, and confirm the revised plan with the candidate and interview team.

  • When scheduling misses turnaround targets, you use Ashby data to diagnose the issue, recommend a change, and track whether performance improves.

  • When an AI agent sends incomplete instructions, you correct the affected communications and partner with Talent Operations to test a fix.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Robinhood Crypto Compliance team partners across the organization to develop, launch, and scale innovative crypto products and services safely and compliantly. As Robinhood’s primary point of contact for crypto compliance, the team provides real-time regulatory guidance, designs robust controls and testing, leads training and supervisory initiatives, and manages escalations across dynamic market environments.

As the Crypto Compliance Senior Lead, you will serve as the Deputy AML Compliance Officer for Robinhood Crypto (RHC) and Bitstamp USA, while extending strategic compliance support to Bitstamp Global. Reporting directly to the Director of Crypto Compliance, you will play a central role in designing, evaluating, and evolving our AML/BSA and financial crimes compliance frameworks. You will work cross-functionally with product, legal, operations, and engineering leaders to uphold the highest compliance standards as our crypto ecosystem expands.

This role is based in our Denver, Menlo Park, New York, Westlake office(s), with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Governance & Oversight: Serve as Deputy AML Compliance Officer for Robinhood Crypto (RHC) and Bitstamp USA, with advisory and operational support for Bitstamp Global.
  • Program Design & Monitoring: Design, implement, test, and monitor critical AML/BSA, OFAC/sanctions, and anti-financial crime controls to ensure compliance with federal, state, and international regulatory expectations.
  • Cross-Functional Advisory: Provide proactive regulatory advice and guidance to product, operations, legal, and business development teams on emerging crypto offerings and industry best practices.
  • Policy Architecture: Draft, update, and maintain comprehensive compliance policies, procedures, and internal playbooks reflecting evolving laws and business lines.
  • Inquiries & Examinations: Partner with the Director of Crypto Compliance on complex investigations and responses related to law enforcement requests, regulatory inquiries, examinations, and banking partner audits.
  • Issue Management & Remediation: Track, validate, and document the timely remediation of control gaps and audit/testing findings within the firm’s issue management systems.
  • Training & Enablement: Develop specialized crypto compliance training curricula and drive enterprise-wide compliance education programs.
  • Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Monitor global crypto regulatory developments and proactively translate evolving guidance into actionable policy, system, and control enhancements.
  • Special Projects: Lead and contribute to strategic compliance initiatives, product launches, and integration efforts across affiliated entities.

What you bring

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience, JD a plus but not required
  • 7+ years in a financial crimes (AML/BSA) compliance role at a regulated financial services company, including crypto or blockchain experience
  • Solid understanding of cryptocurrency markets and blockchain technology
  • Familiarity with anti-money laundering regulations: Bank Secrecy Act, NYCRR Part 504, FATF standards
  • Experience leading projects across technical and non-technical teams in a fast-changing environment
  • Exceptional attention to detail, data analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to effectively summarize findings in a succinct and organized manner
  • Execution oriented mindset with the humility, drive, trustworthiness, and resourcefulness to get things done
  • Sound understanding of compliance and operational risks and internal control frameworks
  • CAMS certification, and experience with blockchain analytics software (E.g., Chainalysis, TRM Labs)

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!

ASSET AND WEALTH MANAGEMENT

Bringing together traditional and alternative investments, we provide clients around the world with a dedicated partnership and focus on long-term performance. As the firm’s primary investment area, we provide investment and advisory services for some of the world’s leading pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, financial advisors and individuals, for which we oversee more than $2 trillion in assets under supervision. Working in a culture that values integrity and transparency, you will be part of a diverse team that is passionate about our craft, our clients, and building sustainable success. We are:

  • Investors, spanning traditional and alternative markets offering products and services.
  • Advisors, understanding our clients’ priorities and poised to help provide investment advice and strategies that make sense for their portfolios.
  • Thought Leaders, providing timely insights across macro and secular themes to help inform our clients’ investment decisions.
  • Innovators, using our suite of digital solutions to help our clients address complex challenges and meet their financial goals.
###HEADING###OPERATIONS

Operations division is a dynamic, multi-faceted organization that partners with all parts of the firm to provide banking, securities, and asset management services to clients around the world. In addition, Operations provides essential risk management and controls to preserve and enhance the firm's assets and its reputation. For every new product launched and every trade executed, it is Operations that develop and manages the processes and controls that enable business flow. 

RESPONSIBILITIES AND QUALIFICATIONS YOUR IMPACT 

We’re looking for a professional individual who wants to apply their understanding of financial markets and be at the heart of regulatory reform. With the continued high rate of change in the regulatory reporting space, Regulatory Operations professionals have the platform to significantly impact their environment and the wider business. 

OUR IMPACT REGULATORY MIDDLE OFFICE OPERATIONS 

The Asset and Wealth Management Division (AWM) delivers asset management and wealth management capabilities to clients around the world. The Operations team is a multi-faceted group that partners with all areas of the division to support evolving markets and business requirements. The Regulatory Middle Office (RMO) is a global team that oversees AWM regulatory reporting and provides SME input into regulatory reform initiatives. The team plays an integral role in ensuring that the Firm meets its regulatory reporting obligations. The Team consists of talented and highly motivated individuals who are extensively involved in the preparation of the mandated reports, as well as the implementation of effective control processes, efficiency initiatives, new compliance and industry change initiatives, BCP, and other department initiatives. To achieve this, the team partners with internal and external stakeholders including Regulators, Custodians, Fund Administrators, Trading Desks, Client Relationship Managers, Engineering, Legal and Compliance.

###HEADING###HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL

Responsibilities include the following: 

• Contribute to the execution of non-financial regulatory reporting obligations (eg. MIFID, EMIR etc.), 

• Reviewing business and functional specifications to determine potential impact to existing regulatory obligations

BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role requires being full-time onsite at our Palo Alto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving. 

If you have spent your career in SOX, internal controls, audit, controllership, or financial close, and you want to build the systems that fix what you find instead of only testing them, this role is for you.

Why this role exists 

Every product BitGo ships eventually becomes a number: a balance, a fee, a statement, a journal entry, a regulatory filing. As a public company and a federally chartered trust bank, we have to prove those numbers are right every period, across many products, legal entities, and jurisdictions. 

You will own the product strategy for the financial and accounting platform that makes those numbers right by construction, as we add products, entities, and asset types. You will turn accounting requirements into scalable, auditable, self-service platform capabilities that product, engineering, finance, and compliance can build on. 

Digital assets make this harder, and more interesting, than it is at a traditional bank. On chain activity, custody structures, staking, tokenized assets, and settlement each move through our systems differently, and each has to land correctly on the books. The industry is still writing the playbook for much of this. You will help write it. 

Level 

We are hiring at Senior or Principal level, depending on experience. The core scope is the same at both. At Principal, you have already set platform strategy, led accounting systems, or established control standards that multiple teams adopted, and you will own the crossproduct standards and the working relationship with finance and audit leadership with more independence from day one.

Two paths to this role 

There is more than one way to be great at this job. You may come from product management and built financial compliance platforms. You may come from audit, controllership, or accounting systems and have spent years finding where numbers break, and then built the thing that fixed it. We are just as interested in the second group. If you are an auditor or accountant with a builder mindset, you will be evaluated on the same scope and the same bar as a product manager. What matters is that you have shipped: tools, automation, control frameworks, or systems that other teams adopted and kept using.

What you will own 

  • The financial data and accounting platform roadmap: Define and deliver the shared capabilities that make financial data trustworthy by construction: ledger and sub-ledger integrity, balance and activity reconciliation, fee and revenue calculation, client reporting, and the feeds into the general ledger and the financial close. 
  • Controls built into the product: Partner with finance, internal audit, and external auditors to turn SOX and internal control requirements into product capabilities instead of manual procedures. When a control needs a build, you own the requirements, the plan, and the timeline, delivered in step with the audit calendar. 
  • Platform standards across products and entities: Make sure new products, new asset types, new legal entities, and acquisitions plug into the platform instead of creating bespoke accounting workarounds. You set the standards, interfaces, and data contracts that product teams build against. 
  • Regulatory and audit readiness: Work with compliance, legal, and risk so the platform supports regulatory reporting, books-and-records requirements, and examiner and auditor requests. You run dated plans against external deadlines and flag early when a timeline is at risk. 
  • Close, reporting, and operational efficiency: Reduce the manual effort, elapsed time, and risk in month-end and quarter-end close. Establish the metrics that show whether the platform is working: reconciliation breaks, close duration, audit adjustments, manual journal volume, and time to onboard a new product. 

What success looks like in the first two quarters 

  • A documented map of how each major product's financial activity reaches the general ledger, with manual steps and gaps identified and prioritized. 
  • A dated platform roadmap agreed with finance, engineering, and compliance, with external deadlines (audit, regulatory, and reporting) built into the plan. 
  • One high-impact capability shipped end to end, such as automated reconciliation for a key product, that measurably reduces manual work or control risk. 

Who you will partner with 

  • Finance and Accounting leadership own accounting policy and judgment. You translate their requirements into platform capabilities and make the product the system of record. 
  • Engineering leadership owns architecture, estimates, and delivery. You partner on sequencing, platform design, and tradeoffs without positional authority. Product Managers across Custody, Trading, Staking, and Financing need the platform to support their products without becoming a bottleneck. 
  • Compliance, Legal, and Risk own regulatory judgment. You build the delivery process behind it. 
  • Internal and external audit rely on you to plan control-related work clearly and deliver it on schedule. 
  • Commercial and client teams need accurate statements, reporting, and billing that clients can trust. 

What we're looking for 

  • 6+ years of experience (typically 9+ for Principal) building or scaling systems, platforms, tooling, or control frameworks that multiple internal or external teams relied on, including 3+ years as the owner. You might have done this as a product manager, or from audit, controllership, or accounting systems. At Principal, you have set strategy or standards that other teams adopted.
  • An accounting or finance foundation: a CPA or equivalent, an accounting degree, or hands-on experience in financial reporting, audit, controllership, or accounting systems. You can read a trial balance, follow a journal entry through a ledger, and discuss revenue recognition or reconciliation with a controller without a translator.
  • Experience building scalable platforms such as ledgers, billing, payments, reporting, data infrastructure, reconciliation tooling, or controls automation. You think in data models, interfaces, and reuse, and you know when a one-off fix will cost us later. If you come from audit or accounting, this may look like automating reconciliations, building controls into a system, or designing data models and tooling with engineers, rather than a formal product title.
  • Experience in a regulated financial environment. You have worked with auditors, examiners, SOX controls, or control programs, and you understand how public company obligations change how products are built and shipped.
  • Technical credibility with Engineers. You can follow an architecture discussion, pressure-test an estimate, and write precise requirements for data-heavy systems. Familiarity with SQL and financial data pipelines is a plus.
  • Crypto or digital-asset experience is a requirement. If you do not have professional experience, passion projects with breadth and depth across digital assets could be a good fit.
  • A writing-first approach: your default artifacts are clear specs, data flow maps, and decision documents.

What will make you fail here 

  • Building bespoke solutions for each product or blockchain instead of platform capabilities that scale. 
  • Needing positional authority to get things done. Engineering, finance, and compliance sit on separate reporting lines, and you will coordinate across all three every day. You need to find ways to unblock yourself. 
  • Optimizing for process over outcomes. We have little patience for ceremony. Here, a control built into the product is an outcome; a new manual review step usually isn't. 

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

  • 100% company-paid health insurance for employee, partner, and dependents
  • Up to 4% 401k company match
  • Paid parental leave, Paid vacation
  • Free commuter/parking pass
  • Free custom lunches and snacks
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and an inspiring environment

Benefits may vary based on location.

Pay Transparency Notice:

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $230,000 and $260,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.
